title: A benchmark finds retained experience can help agents but is often not updated after environment changes
summary: Deterministic task graders measured performance and experience updating under simulated environment changes. These controlled benchmark results do not establish performance in open-ended or deployed environments.
ai_technology: The study compared 20 language-model agents with retained or cleared experience across task streams in 18 environments.
organization: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; Huawei Inc.
